mcu_g_0160_20000350.name: motor_limit_block_out_pair
mcu_g_0160_20000350.description: Two words written by mcu_limit_block_update. Index 0 (0x350) is a copy of the block output at 0x378 (probably the value used by the next cycle). Index 1 (0x354) is the raw param_3 input of the same call (probably the limit before clamping).

mcu_g_0160_20000370.name: motor_limit_block
mcu_g_0160_20000370.description: Limit-block object updated every control tick by mcu_limit_block_update. It holds the two inputs, the selected output (+0x08, copied to 0x350 and 0x3A0), the mode bits, the differences to the limits, and the Q15 bounds and base offset (+0x24 to +0x2C). Field layout is in types/data_motor_batch11.json.

mcu_g_0160_200003dc.name: motor_derate_base_u16
mcu_g_0160_200003dc.description: 16-bit base drive level (probably whole units). mcu_target_derate_calc and mcu_0160_08004E78 scale it by 0x8000 (Q15) and compare it with the B14 band to derate the drive target.

mcu_g_0160_200003de.name: motor_nominal_limit_u16
mcu_g_0160_200003de.description: 16-bit nominal limit in whole units (probably). mcu_init_q14_copies_from_200003de shifts it left by 14 into four Q14 words (0x230, 0x23C, 0x24C, 0x258). Several limit, threshold and power functions read it, some as a divisor (/0x1E, /5).

mcu_g_0160_200003e6.name: motor_limit_hi_cmd_u16
mcu_g_0160_200003e6.description: 16-bit limit value (probably whole units) written from a received CAN command frame by mcu_can_rx_command_dispatch. Read by the derate and threshold functions, shifted by 15 to Q15 for the comparisons.

mcu_g_0160_200003f2.name: motor_q15_gain_u16
mcu_g_0160_200003f2.description: 16-bit Q15 gain (probably a ratio of two limits). mcu_mul_q15_f5e_by_3f2 multiplies it with the 16-bit value at 0x20000F5E and keeps the Q15 result. No writer in this packet.

mcu_g_0160_2000040a.name: motor_speed_threshold_u16
mcu_g_0160_2000040a.description: 16-bit threshold (probably whole speed units). mcu_drive_state_update scales it by 0x8000 (Q15) and uses the comparison as the input of the debounce object at 0x20000D50.

mcu_g_12b_20000628.name: motor_setpoint_ok_12b
mcu_g_12b_20000628.description: 12b-build flag set by mcu_setpoint_slew_limit_v12b to 1 when the scaled setpoint is at or below the output limit at 0x20000F04 (probably 'setpoint within limit').

mcu_g_12b_2000062a.name: motor_slew_counter_12b
mcu_g_12b_2000062a.description: 12b-build counter in mcu_setpoint_slew_limit_v12b. It is cleared to 0 and incremented up to 200 (probably the number of ticks the setpoint has stayed in range).

mcu_g_0160_20000638.name: motor_setpoint_ok_std
mcu_g_0160_20000638.description: Flag set by mcu_setpoint_slew_limit_std to 1 when the scaled setpoint is at or below the output limit at 0x20000F48 (probably 'setpoint within limit'). The 12b build has its own copy, motor_setpoint_ok_12b.

mcu_g_0160_2000063a.name: motor_slew_counters_std
mcu_g_0160_2000063a.description: Two 16-bit counters used by mcu_setpoint_slew_limit_std. Index 0 (0x63A) and index 1 (0x63C) are each cleared to 0 and incremented up to 200 (probably the tick counts for the rising and falling slew).

mcu_g_0160_2000065a.name: motor_limit_mode
mcu_g_0160_2000065a.description: Limit mode index, 0 to 3. It is the index into the pointer table at 0x20000268 and is copied to 0x20000677 by mcu_0160_0800ADDE, which sets it to 2 or 3. mcu_update_flag_e32_from_mode_3 tests it for 3.

mcu_g_0160_2000065d.name: motor_mode_bits
mcu_g_0160_2000065d.description: Mode bit field. Bit 0 is one condition in mcu_cond_mode_bit0_and_level_ok, and bit 1 (inverted) is read by mcu_mode_bit1_inverted. Bits 3 and 4 feed mcu_update_motion_direction_flags. Written in mcu_0160_0800ADDE.

mcu_g_0160_20000660.name: motor_limit_min3
mcu_g_0160_20000660.description: Minimum of three limit values in Q15 (probably). mcu_get_limit_min3_or_unbounded returns it clamped to at least 0x18000, and 0 means no limit applies. Written by mcu_0160_0800B10C, which sets it to 0 and then slews it with FUN_08002982 (step 0x51E).

mcu_g_0160_20000664.name: motor_cmd_ramp_limit
mcu_g_0160_20000664.description: Slew-limited value, probably the commanded drive limit. mcu_cmd_ramp_update resets it to 0 and slews it with FUN_08002982 (step 0x333 per tick). mcu_target_derate_calc compares it with a derived bound.

mcu_g_12b_20000664.name: motor_cmd_ramp_limit_12b
mcu_g_12b_20000664.description: The same slew-limited command limit in the 12b build. mcu_cmd_ramp_update resets it to 0 and slews it with FUN_08002982 (step 0x333).

mcu_g_152_20000664.name: motor_sample_hist_word_152
mcu_g_152_20000664.description: 152-only word at 0x20000664. It is accessed through a pointer by mcu_sample_history3_rise_detect (read and write) and mcu_0160_08005E28. It probably belongs to the 152 build's sample-history block (the 0160 build keeps its history at 0x20000670). Meaning is not visible in this packet.

mcu_g_0160_20000668.name: motor_limit_668_value
mcu_g_0160_20000668.description: Limit value written by mcu_cmd_ramp_update. mcu_limit_668_or_default returns it when the default-limit enable is set (otherwise 0.5, 0x4000). mcu_0160_08003F2C divides it by 10.

mcu_g_0160_2000066c.name: motor_timed_hold_flag
mcu_g_0160_2000066c.description: Flag set to 1 by mcu_timed_hold_countdown when a timed hold starts and cleared to 0 when it ends. mcu_run_enable_update reads it to keep run enabled during the hold (probably).

mcu_g_0160_2000066f.name: motor_fault_level_units
mcu_g_0160_2000066f.description: Level in whole units of 0x8000 (Q15 1.0). mcu_0160_0800B10C sets it to 7 or to its previous value plus 2. mcu_0160_08003F2C compares (value - 3) * 0x8000 and value * 0x8000 with the speed-like value at 0x20000F30 (probably a speed window).

mcu_g_0160_20000670.name: motor_sample_history3
mcu_g_0160_20000670.description: Three-deep history of 0 to 200 samples. Index 0 (0x670) is the newest and index 2 (0x672) the oldest. mcu_sample_history3_rise_detect pushes a sample in and sets a flag when three consecutive rises are each larger than 0x23 (probably a fast-rise detector).

mcu_g_0160_20000673.name: motor_rise_hold_count
mcu_g_0160_20000673.description: Countdown set to 20 (0x14) by mcu_sample_history3_rise_detect and decremented by mcu_0160_0800ADDE while it is positive (probably hold-off ticks after a detected rise).

mcu_g_0160_20000674.name: motor_cmd_pending_flag
mcu_g_0160_20000674.description: Flag tested for 1 and then cleared by mcu_cmd_ramp_update (probably a one-shot command latch). Present in the 0160 build only.

mcu_g_0160_20000680.name: motor_rise_detect_val
mcu_g_0160_20000680.description: Q15 value written by mcu_sample_history3_rise_detect from the new sample (scaled by 0xFFF and rounded, then shifted). mcu_0160_0800ADDE compares it with 0x2000067C (probably the reference for the rise test).

mcu_g_0160_20000684.name: motor_cmd_upper_bound
mcu_g_0160_20000684.description: Upper bound of the command ramp, computed by mcu_cmd_ramp_update as (DAT_20001FD6 >> 14) * uVar2 * 0x2000 or as (DAT_20001FE4 & 0xFF) << 15. It is used in the ramp test with the previous command at 0x200001FC.

mcu_g_12b_20000720.name: motor_speed_band_flag_12b
mcu_g_12b_20000720.description: 12b-build boolean set by mcu_12b_speed_lpf_band_update from a comparison with -0x10001 (probably a speed band window).

mcu_g_0160_20000734.name: motor_speed_band_flag
mcu_g_0160_20000734.description: Boolean set by mcu_speed_lpf_band_update from comparisons with -0x280001, -0x140001 and -0x10001 (probably the speed band that selects the filter alpha).

mcu_g_0160_20000738.name: motor_ctrl_ramp_out
mcu_g_0160_20000738.description: Output of mcu_ctrl_ramp_limit_update: the ramped control output (probably consumed by the controller).

mcu_g_0160_20000758.name: motor_vec_xy_758
mcu_g_0160_20000758.description: 28-byte object passed by address to FUN_08005830 by several limit functions. FUN_08005830 reads words +0x14 and +0x18 of it (0x20000770 is the second one) as the two components of a vector and computes its magnitude. The rest of the layout is not in this packet (probably the magnitude filter state).

mcu_g_0160_20000780.name: motor_speed_mismatch_cmd
mcu_g_0160_20000780.description: Signed value whose magnitude is used by mcu_limit_chan_cfg_d and mcu_0160_08005930. mcu_speed_mismatch_check sets status bit 0x4000 when this value is large while the command is near zero (probably a speed mismatch alarm).

mcu_g_0160_200008b4.name: motor_limit_chan_gain_a
mcu_g_0160_200008b4.description: Gain constant reloaded by mcu_limit_chan_update_c (0x1A666 or 0x6999) and by mcu_limit_chan_cfg_d (0x6999). 0x6999 is 0.8 in Q15, the same gain that mcu_limit_chan_cfg_d uses.

mcu_g_0160_200008bc.name: motor_limit_chan_gain_b
mcu_g_0160_200008bc.description: Second constant reloaded by mcu_limit_chan_update_c (0xA50000 or 0x294000) and by mcu_limit_chan_cfg_d (0x294000). Probably a Q16 limit paired with motor_limit_chan_gain_a.

mcu_g_0160_200008f8.name: motor_position_latch_pair
mcu_g_0160_200008f8.description: Two position words. Index 0 (0x8F8) is the return value of FUN_080031B8 (probably the current position read). Index 1 (0x8FC) is a copy of index 0, latched by mcu_position_zero_and_latch when the multi-turn position is rebased (probably the reference).

mcu_g_0160_20000a44.name: motor_bus_filter_val
mcu_g_0160_20000a44.description: Filter state for the value at 0x20000A40 (not in this packet). mcu_fault_monitor_update filters A40 into it with FUN_0800721A and coefficient 0x23A3A3C0 (probably a slow time constant). Read by mcu_0160_08003F2C and mcu_target_derate_calc.

mcu_g_0160_20000a9a.name: motor_limit_default_en
mcu_g_0160_20000a9a.description: Enable flag for the default limit. mcu_limit_668_or_default copies it into the latch at 0x200000B5, and mcu_cond_658_and_not_a9a requires it to be zero (probably).

mcu_g_0160_20000b14.name: motor_bus_voltage_q15
mcu_g_0160_20000b14.description: Band value in Q15, probably the bus voltage. mcu_target_derate_calc, mcu_limit_target_b3c_update and mcu_bus_threshold_monitor compare it with band limits (0x2F7FFF, 0x348000, 0x370000 and the thresholds 0x3E8 and 0x3EA). mcu_fault_monitor_update writes it.

mcu_g_12b_20000b1c.name: motor_status_word_b1c_12b
mcu_g_12b_20000b1c.description: 12b-build status word whose bits are set by the threshold monitors (bits 0x1, 0x2 and 0x20 per their summaries). Accessed through a pointer here, so the other bits are not visible in this packet (probably the fault status).

mcu_g_0160_20000b20.name: motor_tick_counter_b20
mcu_g_0160_20000b20.description: 16-bit counter used as a speed or time gate: speed functions test it above 500, mcu_update_motion_direction_flags tests it below 20, and mcu_run_enable_update tests it above 49. Written by mcu_0160_0800A320 (probably a tick or speed count).

mcu_g_143_20000b20.name: motor_tick_counter_b20_143
mcu_g_143_20000b20.description: 143-build word at 0x20000B20, accessed through a pointer by mcu_limit_chan_cfg_high_seed and mcu_0160_08003F2C. It probably holds the same kind of counter as motor_tick_counter_b20 in the 0160 build, with a different layout.

mcu_g_0160_20000b3c.name: motor_limit_target_b3c
mcu_g_0160_20000b3c.description: Limited target value in Q15, computed by mcu_limit_target_b3c_update from the B14 band and the base at 0x200003DE. Its address is passed to FUN_080057E8 and FUN_08007198 as the output of the limiter at 0x20000C3C.

mcu_g_0160_20000b40.name: motor_limit_hi_b40
mcu_g_0160_20000b40.description: Upper limit value. mcu_limit_chan_cfg_high_seed uses it as the seed when it is at most motor_limit_lo_b48, and mcu_0160_08003F2C compares it with the speed value (probably in Q15 units).

mcu_g_0160_20000b48.name: motor_limit_lo_b48
mcu_g_0160_20000b48.description: Lower limit value (probably), compared with motor_limit_hi_b40 by mcu_limit_chan_cfg_high_seed and mcu_0160_08003F2C.

mcu_g_0160_20000b4c.name: motor_limit_seed_w4
mcu_g_0160_20000b4c.description: Seed value copied to word 4 of the destination struct by mcu_limit_chan_cfg_high_seed. mcu_0160_08003F2C compares it with the speed value at 0x20000F30 (probably a Q15 half-scale threshold).
